title: Retired dual-channel derivative claim (corrected identity under verification)
statement: RETRACTED: The prior assertion F'(x) = x/(1+x) is false for F(x) = x^2/2 - x + ln(1+x). Direct differentiation gives F'(x) = x - 1 + 1/(1+x) = x^2/(1+x). The retired constitutive definition mu(x)=x/(1+x) is not this derivative.
